reviewed_by: Automated static review (Binary Ninja + Radare2 CFG, signature, behaviour note)

runtime_contract.note: The live differential compares the calls that naturally happened, with the argument words and the result of each call. A pointer value from one process is not the data of the other, so a non-scalar argument is compared as the word it was, and the report says which scope it used.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Retail 0x004C5F00 (Terrain_LoadTexturesAndLightmaps): sub esp,0x484; strcpy g_b97c20,path; name=path+.tex; Terrain_LoadTexFile -> ctx+0xDBC; palette[i]=i<<16 uploaded to ctx+0xDF4; if GetTerrainLightmapsUsed: name=path+.lmp -> ctx+0xE00, Resource_Load, per-entry Texture_UploadMipmapPacket into g_b81b20 (0x2C stride); return Resource_Unload(name). The candidate is the same instruction sequence in C++ using the retail global addresses. No Frida run yet.
